name: Daily Branding
summary: Branding archive of 172 projects with the agencies and designers behind them, plus websites and fonts.
description: Daily Branding collects branding projects from around the world and features the agencies and creators behind them. Sections cover branding projects, featured website designs, typography inspiration and articles, with a directory of agencies and designers to hire and a form to submit work.
